card.name: Substrate or inhibitor of enzymes and transporters
card.fires_on: The word substrate (or inhibitor, inducer) and the following "of" when a label says a drug is or is not a substrate of an enzyme or transporter such as CYP3A or OATP. Also partway through the word substrates.
